source_user: A team wants lower serving cost through weight-only quantization. Define a fair comparison. Scenario variant 84: include an explicit falsifiable hypothesis and a controlled experiment.
source_assistant: Answer should state assumptions, a falsifiable hypothesis, measurements, expected confounders, and rollback criteria. Minimum technical points: fix model and prompts; compare quality, memory, TTFT, TPOT, throughput, concurrency, kernel support, calibration set, and failure cases; report confidence intervals.
corrected_answer: Assume identical checkpoint, tokenizer, request trace, decoding, server/runtime, scheduler, hardware, drivers, power and thermal state. Change only weight precision; keep activation and KV-cache precision fixed. Record format, group size, scales, outliers, calibration provenance, disjoint held-out tests, kernel support and fallbacks. Hypothesis: at declared concurrency, quantization lowers fully loaded cost per successful output token while meeting preregistered quality, safety, correctness, TTFT and TPOT limits. Use randomized interleaved paired baseline/treatment trials after warm-up and compilation, repeat and report confidence intervals. Measure quality, safety and correctness, model/peak memory, TTFT and TPOT in ms, throughput in tokens/s, concurrency, utilization, errors, retries, timeouts, OOMs, kernel/fallback behavior, cleanup and p95/p99 with units and sample sizes. Log prompt mix, batching, cache state, background load, throttling and retry policy as confounders; separate measured facts from estimates and include failed work in cost. Reject and restore the baseline for any hard-gate or reliability regression, material fallback, leak, or unsupported savings. Use authorized bounded testing with capped canary exposure, redacted telemetry, monitoring, a watchdog and a reversible switch.
risks: Runtime, kernel fallback, hardware state, batching, or workload mix can confound attribution.
Synthetic held-out results may not predict production quality or safety.
Cost estimates can omit host, power, storage, or failed-request overhead.
evidence_required: Exact checkpoint, runtime, hardware, drivers, quantizer and calibration configuration.
Disjoint calibration and held-out sets with quality, safety, correctness, latency, resource and failure measurements.
Repeated paired trial logs, sample sizes, tail metrics and confidence-interval calculations.
Kernel/fallback, cleanup, authorization, halt-condition and rollback records.
